about: Each essay's cover: <slug>.jpg (1400 px wide, 16:9) and the sizes and formats tools/build-covers.sh writes from it. alt describes the illustration and what it argues; the essay's title, which the cover also carries, is the heading right after it. Read by tools/site-data.cjs.

the-agent-cant-be-its-own-checker.alt: A steel lock plate with two keyholes: one key already turned, the second keyhole empty, waiting for an independent key to close it.

ai-collapsed-the-build.alt: A finished mantel clock and a hand turning the key in its face: built once, it still has to be wound by hand.

the-unit-of-production-has-changed.alt: A ship's wheel that once needed a crew, steered by a single hand.

the-assistant-that-knows-you.alt: A desk lamp bent low over an open notebook full of handwriting, lighting what is already written there.

always-on-assistant.alt: A lit lantern hanging beside a front door that is held by a short chain: always on, and only as open as you allow.

building-a-second-brain.alt: A leafy plant growing out of a stack of closed notebooks, its roots wrapped around them.

in-clawd-we-trust.alt: A hand pointing at one spot on an architect's plan, a set square resting on the sheet: the person directs the build.

prediction-markets.alt: A compass whose needle is made of many separate iron filings lined up to point one way.

tesserakt-protocol.alt: A wire-frame cube inside a larger cube, every corner joined to its partner by a rod.

the-missing-infrastructure-for-ai-agents.alt: A modern car stuck with its wheels sunk in a rutted cart track marked with hoofprints.

autonomous-ai-agents.alt: A clockwork bird in flight with a winding key in its back, carrying a sealed envelope in its beak.

the-democratic-myth-of-daos.alt: A balance scale where a single king piece outweighs a crowd of pawns on the other pan.

beyond-lean.alt: Two ladders side by side: the short one stops halfway, the other carries on well above it.

market-segmentation.alt: A peeled orange split into its segments, one segment drawn apart from the rest.

the-beachhead-market.alt: A small rowing boat pulled up on a narrow beach, a flag planted in the sand beside it.

building-your-end-user-profile.alt: A pair of worn work boots, laces loose, soles caked in mud.

why-every-tam-slide-is-a-lie.alt: A hand laying one brick on a short, solid stack, while a huge empty bubble floats above it.

building-your-persona.alt: A signpost whose blank arrows all point up at a single star.

mapping-your-full-customer-journey.alt: A long winding path of stepping stones leading up to a front door.

drawing-your-product-brochure.alt: A finished model house set on an empty plot that is only marked out with pegs and string.

quantifying-your-value-proposition.alt: A spring scale weighing a basket of fruit, its pointer swung well along the dial.

finding-your-first-10-customers.alt: A hand holding a fountain pen, its nib on the signature line of a page.

define-your-core.alt: An intact anvil with a hammer on it, standing in a ring of fallen wall stones.

charting-your-competitive-position.alt: A sagging old armchair with a deep dent in its cushion, beside a new chair nobody has sat in.

the-decision-making-unit.alt: A door with five locks: a hand turns the key in the top one while the four below stay shut.

mapping-the-customer-acquisition-process.alt: A small pocket map unfolding into a long zigzag strip of panels covered in route marks.

calculating-tam-for-follow-on-markets.alt: A dinner plate with only crumbs left, beside a cake still untouched under a glass dome.

designing-your-business-model.alt: A water wheel turning in a stream, water pouring onto its paddles.

setting-your-pricing-framework.alt: A great carved door, shut, with the small plain key that opens it lying in front.

calculating-customer-ltv.alt: A bucket filling from a tap while water leaks from a hole near its base.

mapping-the-sales-process.alt: A single line of footprints crossing deep, untrodden snow.

calculating-cac-honestly.alt: An iceberg at the waterline: a small tip above, a vast mass below.

identifying-your-key-assumptions.alt: A sturdy table with three turned legs, its fourth corner held up by a wobbly stack of matchboxes.

testing-your-assumptions.alt: A long stick tapping the ice at the edge of a frozen pond before anyone steps onto it.

why-your-mvp-is-already-too-big.alt: A napkin with a few rectangles sketched on it, in front of a tall stack of thick printed documents.

will-the-dogs-eat-the-dog-food.alt: A dog's bowl licked completely clean, one crumb beside it.

developing-your-product-plan.alt: A wooden cart wheel, its spokes reaching out from a solid hub to the rim.
